name: remove-phrase-end
description:
The words at the end of a phrase, cut until the last word is clean; remove only.

kind: "prepositions" (prepositions and the other function words of the stopword list: «диван в и» → «диван») or "buy_markers" (the words of the bundled list «sale», whole phrases of it too: «диван купить недорого» → «диван»; a marker right after a preposition stays: «диван с доставкой купить» → «диван с доставкой»). Words compare in any case, ё as е, as written («для,» with its comma stays). A phrase of such words only becomes an empty cell.

remove-phrase-end removes what the matcher finds from the working column.

Example: semkit read core.csv remove-phrase-end prepositions write out.csv
